text: This horror demo shipped with two AI agent runtimes inside it.
Not one. Two. Plus a tokenizer, in a game about a haunted fort.
It's Rudravati, a first-person Indian horror that went up on Steam yesterday.
It's Unity on Mono, so the package list is readable. In it: MCP for Unity, and Unity's own MCP runtime.
MCP is what lets an AI agent drive the Unity editor. Finding it here means nobody stripped it out.
Beside them, an inference engine with a tokenizer, and DirectML.
Worth a dip if you like slow horror. Open your own build and search it for MCP.
Every demo I open, I read the file list first. That's the whole channel.
